Name: (FF)Animal Statues Furniture-Unofficial
Author: nbv158
Description:
[quote][b][color=#ff0000][size=5]﻿Unofficial update for "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12426]Animal Statues for Custom Furniture (CF)[/url]﻿" by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lydocia?gameId=1303]lydocia[/url]﻿[/size][/color][/b][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]
[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][u][b]I have obtained permission from the original author, lydocia.This mod will be available until lydocia either tells me to take it down or updates the original mod.[/b][/u][/size][/color][/quote][size=3]Adds 14 small animal statues and 10 large animal statues to the game, each available in both wooden and golden versions. Can be placed both indoors and outdoors.

I have added Chinese translation for this mod. If you need translations in other languages, you can translate them yourself and then upload them to me, or use them on your own.

Since the original mod's prerequisite mod is no longer functional, I have updated it using "Furniture Framework."
[/size]
[size=3]You can now find these statues both in the Furniture Framework's [/size]catalogue[size=3] and in the game's Furniture Catalogue[/size][size=3].

[/size][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]If you would like to recolor the Chicken Statue and Bear Statue with Alternative Textures, please download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12427]this version[/url] made by the same author.[/size][/color][color=#f1f1f1][size=3]
[/size][/color]
[size=3]Installation：
[/size][size=3]1. Install SMAPI
[/size][size=3]2. Install [/size]Furniture Framework
[size=3]3. Download the .zip file and extract into your /Mods folder
[/size]
[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]If you experience any problem or bug, contact with us in the "Posts" or "Bugs" section[/b]

[b]It is best to submit it in the "bug" tab.As I might miss them in the general posts tab.[/b][/size]
[/color]

[quote][size=4]﻿[b][color=#ff0000]对来自[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lydocia?gameId=1303]lydocia[/url]﻿的“[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12426]Animal Statues for Custom Furniture (CF)[/url]﻿”模组的非官方更新[/color][/b][/size]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]我已获得原作者[/u][/size][/color][/b][u][size=5]lydocia[/size][/u][b][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]的许可。本模组将持续可用，直至[/u][/size][/color][/b][u][size=5]lydocia[/size][/u][b][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]要求下架或更新原版模组。[/u][/size][/color][/b][/quote][size=3]为游戏增加了14个小型动物雕像，10个大型动物雕像，它们都拥有木制与金制两个版本。室内外皆可放置。

我为这个模组添加了中文翻译，如果你需要其他语言的翻译，可以自行翻译后找到我上传或者自行使用。

[/size][size=3]由于原模组的前置模组已无法使用，我使用“Furniture Framework”对原模组进行了更新。
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]现在，你既可以在Furniture Framework的目录中找到这些雕像，也可以在游戏自带的家具目录中找到它们。
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]如果您想用Alternative Textures为鸡雕像和熊雕像进行纹理替换，请下载同作者制作的[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12427]此版本[/url]﻿。
[/size]
[size=3]安装教程：[/size]
[size=3]1. 安装SMAPI
[/size][size=3]2. 安装[/size]Furniture Framework
[size=3]3. 下载.zip文件并解压到您的/Mods文件夹

[/size][color=#ffff00][size=4][b]若遇到任何问题或错误，请在"讨论区"或"错误反馈"板块联系我们

最好在“错误反馈”板块进行提交，因为我可能会在常规讨论区中遗漏它们[/b][/size][/color]
